original_question: Does there exist a probability measure defined on the weak Borel sigma-algebra Bo(ℓ_∞, w) that does not admit any extension to a probability measure on the norm Borel sigma-algebra Bo(ℓ_∞)?
target_in_paper: §2.2, Problem 2.6 (Fremlin): "Is there a probability on Bo(ℓ∞, w) which cannot be extended to a probability on Bo(ℓ∞)?" ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper's official formulation: it singles out ℓ∞, uses the weak Borel σ-algebra Bo(ℓ∞, w) and the norm Borel σ-algebra Bo(ℓ∞), and asks exactly for the existence of a probability that has no extension from the former to the latter, which is precisely the content of Problem 2.6. ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))
missing_details: The paper's ambient convention is that all Banach spaces are real, so ℓ∞ should be understood as the real Banach space of bounded real sequences. ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))
The symbol w should be made explicit as the weak topology on ℓ∞. ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))

Bo(ℓ∞) should be identified explicitly as the Borel σ-algebra of the norm topology, i.e. the supremum-norm topology on ℓ∞. ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))

To be fully stand-alone, 'does not admit any extension' should be unpacked as: there is no probability ν on Bo(ℓ∞) whose restriction to Bo(ℓ∞, w) equals the given probability μ. ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))
refined_question: Let ℓ∞ be the real Banach space of bounded real sequences equipped with the supremum norm, let w denote its weak topology, and let Bo(ℓ∞, w) and Bo(ℓ∞) be the Borel σ-algebras of the weak and norm topologies, respectively. Does there exist a probability measure μ on Bo(ℓ∞, w) for which there is no probability measure ν on Bo(ℓ∞) satisfying ν|Bo(ℓ∞, w) = μ? ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))
justification: The draft is already almost verbatim Problem 2.6 in §2.2. The only refinements needed to make it fully stand-alone and paper-faithful are the paper's ambient conventions and notation: real Banach spaces, w for the weak topology, and Bo(ℓ∞) for the norm-topology Borel σ-algebra. I did not broaden the question to arbitrary Banach spaces, because the paper itself asks the problem specifically for ℓ∞ and notes that a positive answer would imply that (ℓ∞, w) is not Radon. ([webs.um.es](https://webs.um.es/joserr/miwiki/lib/exe/fetch.php?cache=cache&id=papers&media=openproblems.pdf))
